entries.title: Seeds and preserved hair in tomb point to oldest signs of cannabis high 2,800 years ago, study suggests
entries.snippet: Archaeologists who led a dig at a monumental tomb in Siberia said they turned up evidence of the earliest known use of cannabis for psychoactive purposes.

entries.title: Dad of 20-year-old co-pilot in Florida jet crash says her final radio calls showed 'she's tough'
entries.snippet: "I wanted to be by her side," Allan Filgueiras, a pilot who helped teach his daughter to fly, said at a news conference Friday, at times holding back tears. "Inside the plane. To help."

entries.title: Cornell faculty vote 'no confidence' in university leadership after alleged fraternity gang rape
entries.snippet: While the faculty body has no power over the university's top leaders, backers of the resolution had said they hoped it would pressure Cornell's trustees to address longstanding institutional failures they identified.

entries.title: Democrats win the Arizona House, Senate and governor's office for the first time since 1966
entries.snippet: The Associated Press called enough legislative races to confirm that both chambers flipped on Friday.

entries.title: WATCH: 'Elections matter.' Houston mayor limits police cooperation with ICE
entries.snippet: The shift in the nation's fourth-largest city is one of the first actions to restrict U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement operations since Democrats' rout in Tuesday's midterm elections.

entries.title: Trump's triumphal arch is blocked for now, but a new website highlights the plans
entries.snippet: The White House highlighted the website the morning after U.S. District Judge Tanya Chutkan issued a temporary restraining order that prohibits work on the site for 14 days.

entries.title: Connecticut Sen. Chris Murphy released from hospital after stroke
entries.snippet: The 53-year-old Democrat said in a statement Friday that doctors are "encouraged by the progress" he's made so far.

entries.title: Schumer says Democrats will stop Trump from placing 'right-winger' on the Supreme Court
entries.snippet: Schumer says the party's agenda will center around lowering prices, along with five issues that they have focused on in the minority — healthcare, housing, Trump's tariffs, childcare and lowering energy bills.

entries.title: Trump names Stephen Miller his next chief of staff after major Republican midterm losses
entries.snippet: President Trump's White House chief of staff, Susie Wiles, is stepping down. She is Trump's longest-serving chief of staff and the first woman ever to hold the position.

entries.title: Latino voters propel Democrats to big wins with leftward swing
entries.snippet: Hispanic voters, especially those in the working class, have been impacted by economic challenges, leading them to reject President Donald Trump and his Republican Party.

entries.title: 3 charged in $129 million AI scheme targeting thousands of companies
entries.snippet: Their victims included hospital systems in Missouri and California, a bank in Rhode Island, a financial technology company in the United Kingdom, a mutual fund company in Massachusetts and a pet food company in Florida, according to court documents.

entries.title: Online magazine Salon announces it is shutting down
entries.snippet: Salon said there were no immediate plans to take down its online archives, which include three decades of stories from across the world and across topics and genres.

entries.snippet: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

entries.title: Germany hopes to host world ice hockey championship — without Russia
entries.snippet: International protests continue after a court ruled that Russia must be allowed to return to international ice hockey. Germany is seeking a solution that will allow the country to host next year's world championship.

entries.title: France braces for new round of Yellow Vest, student protests
entries.snippet: Two major protests have been announced for Saturday. One will see students and unions marching against high living costs, while the Yellow Vests plan to march separately, despite a police ban.

entries.title: Ukraine: Russia hits Kyiv with airstrikes ahead of trilateral talks
entries.snippet: The strikes hit a major bridge and energy facilities in the Kyiv region. President Volodymyr Zelenskyy accused Moscow of trying to "push" Ukraine "into a blackout" ahead of talks in Abu Dhabi.

entries.title: Germany news: Frankfurt braces for Iran protests
entries.snippet: An appearance by Iranian opposition figure Reza Pahlavi is expected to trigger demonstrations in Frankfurt. Meanwhile, Germany's defense minister says he believes military conscription will not be needed. DW has more.

entries.title: Amid protests, France's rising debt costs threaten stability
entries.snippet: France plans to spend an extra €4 billion on education amid nationwide protests. But with public debt mounting and interest costs climbing, how much fiscal room does the government have?

entries.title: US: Giant pandas from China make public debut at Atlanta zoo
entries.snippet: Ping Ping and Fu Shuang are the first giant pandas to be housed in Zoo Atlanta after a gap of two years.

entries.title: India news: Vehicles major cause of Delhi pollution, top court says
entries.snippet: India's Supreme Court called for responsible celebrations during festivals, particularly Diwali, as it addressed the issue of air pollution in Delhi. DW has more.

entries.title: US asks China to uphold Busan trade deal commitments
entries.snippet: The US urged Beijing to meet commitments from a 2025 accord — particularly on agricultural purchases and rare earths supply. China, meanwhile, expressed concern over the US' "economic, trade restrictive" measures.

entries.title: Cornell faculty declares 'no confidence' in university leadership
entries.snippet: The university leadership has faced intense criticism for its handling of sexual crimes on campus since a former student filed a lawsuit saying she was drugged and raped at a fraternity house in October 2024.

entries.title: Paraguay: President Santiago Pena under house arrest over bank crisis
entries.snippet: Paraguay’s Senate has ousted President Santiago Pena over the collapse of a major bank tied to his government. Millions of customers' accounts are frozen, with public pension and health care funds also tied up.

entries.title: Pope Leo arrives in Uruguay at start of South America tour
entries.snippet: Pope Leo has arrived in Uruguay at the start of a 12-day trip through three South American nations. His trip, which is intense with a packed itinerary, comes just weeks after his lung cancer surgery.

entries.title: Tankers carrying Russian diesel to the US change course
entries.snippet: Despite an ostensible deal between Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin to bring diesel to the US, tankers are reportedly unable to dock due to existing sanctions.

entries.title: Stephen Miller named by Trump as new White House chief of staff
entries.snippet: The US president said he would be replacing Susie Wiles for the top advisory role. Stephen Miller is a controversial figure, known as a key architect of the administration's hard-line immigration policies.

entries.title: Ueno Bank scandal plunges Paraguay into political crisis
entries.snippet: Suspected financial fraud, public money at risk and millions of customers affected: Paraguay is in serious crisis following the sudden collapse of Ueno Bank. President Santiago Pena is facing impeachment.

entries.title: Critics say Democrats should look into Trump's Middle East deals in future corruption investigations
entries.snippet: After their victory in the US midterm elections, the Democrats have promised to investigate corruption in the Trump administration. Critics say the president's Middle East deals is an area they should focus on.

entries.title: Ilse Aigner tipped by party allies as next German president
entries.snippet: German media reports suggest that Bavarian politician Ilse Aigner's chances of becoming the next president are on the up. Long favored by her Bavarian CSU, now it seems Christian Democrats nationwide plan to back her.

entries.title: Meghan Markle's father arrested in US over child sex abuse material
entries.snippet: US federal agents arrested Thomas Markle in Florida. The Duchess of Sussex and television actress Meghan Markle, who is estranged from her father, said she was "deeply distressed" by the charges.

entries.title: Iran war: Gulf tanker attacked, 1 seaferer killed
entries.snippet: Iran is stepping up attacks on shipping in the Persian Gulf and Strait of Hormuz. A Greek-owned tanker believed to have been struck with a missile, and Iran said two other vessels were on fire.

entries.title: Tesla to 'wind down' production of flop Cybertruck
entries.snippet: Elon Musk's electric pickup for the future will start to be consigned to the past next year. The Cybertruck's bulk and crude shape meant it could only pass regulatory standards in more permissive markets.
